About the Show

A field journal, read out loud

Dreams and astrology have held Sam's attention since he was twelve — and in the decades since, alchemy and the Demartini Method joined them. It's all taught him one thing: underneath the chaos of ordinary life, there's an order. It doesn't show up on schedule — but once you learn to look for it, you start seeing it everywhere. Each episode is a page from that field journal, shared so you can test the patterns against your own life.

What you'll hear
  • — Dreams as data, not mystery
  • — Alchemy, astrology & correspondence
  • — The Pauli–Jung conjecture, in plain terms
  • — Field notes from real moments of friction
